description: Integrate enumeration interactions into authoring and all study surfaces, add adaptive Learn routing at /review/test, and verify end-to-end behavior.
steps: Add enumeration Identification and Multiple Choice renderer branches, QuizRunner plumbing, and FlashcardReview two-column answer rendering with accessible unavailable/privacy states.
Add answer-term/quota/distractor authoring controls and exact empty-options payload behavior in QuizQuestionFormModal and ManualQuizCreator.

Implement learnModeDispatcher and new sibling route apps/web/app/(app)/review/test/[quizId]/page.tsx by copying the practice/[quizId] authorization/loading/mastery contract; add Learn entry to QuizStartConfigModal.

Add component, authoring, dispatcher, route, runtime, and browser smoke tests covering quota progression, wrong/right counting, duplicate suppression, typed matching, flashcard grid, owner/shared/subject-shared/legacy/missing route cases, and reload.
acceptance_criteria: Enumeration flashcards show all visible terms in two columns on wide screens and one column on narrow screens.
Identification and multiple choice continue until unique attempted selections equal the quota and show the final verdict only then.
Learn mode dispatches enumeration, exact true/false, ordinary multiple choice, and typed-answer questions without numeric-term evaluation.
/review/test/<quizId> renders QuizRunner for owner/shared/subject-shared cases, redirects legacy IDs preserving query, and notFounds missing quizzes.
